alex (intern-dev): Hey, trying the python quickstart with docker-compose. First call errors with a 403 and body says "workspace_on_hold". I mounted the API key as a docker secret per the sample compose.

tara (devex): Welcome! Which quickstart file did you use? We recently added a docker secret example.

alex (intern-dev): Using `docker-compose.yml` from examples/python. I set a secret named `redwood_key` and referenced it in the service. Command: `docker-compose up --build -d`

rui (sdk): Quick check: the Python SDK reads env var REDWOOD_API_KEY at process start. Docker secrets appear as files at `/run/secrets/<name>`. Our sample compose uses an entrypoint script to export the secret into env, but older copies forgot to copy the script. Can you paste the compose snippet?

alex (intern-dev): snippet: ```yaml
services:
  app:
    build: .
    secrets: [redwood_key]
secrets:
  redwood_key:
    external: true
```
I didn't see an entrypoint in the image, I thought compose would auto-expose it.

tara (devex): That's the gap. We changed samples to use a tiny `docker-entrypoint.sh` that does `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat /run/secrets/redwood_key)` but the example image in examples/python still points to the old base image. We'll update the README to call this out.

maya (billing-cs): I pulled your org (org: alex-sandbox) 1:00AM UTC and status is "Account hold: unpaid invoice". Workspaces on hold are blocked from certain production endpoints and return workspace_on_hold for first-call attempts. If you want immediate sandbox access, I can enable a 48-hour unlock for dev testing.

rui (sdk): Two action items from our side: 1) make the Python quickstart log a clear diagnostic when neither REDWOOD_API_KEY env var nor `/run/secrets/*` are present; 2) add a fallback that looks for common secret filenames and prints a friendly hint. I'll open PR SDK-742.

tara (devex): I'll update examples/python README and add a note about SSO/billing modal leaving accounts on hold. Also will pin the compose example to include the entrypoint script and a tiny example of converting secret to env.

tara (devex): Nice. Follow-ups: small README PR, compose sample update, and adding a runtime check in the quickstart that fails with a human message if workspace_on_hold is received.
